30%~ 911777 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT made as of this / day of October, 2018 (this "Agreement") by and among LARGAVISTA QP 41sT LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at 275 Madison Avenue, 37th Floor, New York, New York 10016,LARGAVISTA 41sT HOLDINGS, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at 275 Madison Avenue, 37th Floor, New York, New York 10016, and LVC 125TH, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company,having an address at 275 Madison Avenue, 37th Floor, New York,New York 10016 (collectively, “Owner"), PALMANA REALTY CORP., a New York corporation, having an address at 275 Madison Avenue, 37th Floor, New York, New York 10016 ("Lot 6/12 Developer"), and QSB NORTHERN, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 757 Third Avenue, Suite 1701, New York, New York 10017 ("Lot 13 Developer"). RECITALS: A. Owner is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, known as 29-42 Northern Boulevard and 30-10/12 41st Avenue, Queens, New York, and identified on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Queens (the “Tax Map") as Block 239, Lots 23 and 26, respectively, which is more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (the “Owner Land"; the Owner Land together with any buildings, improvements, or other structures now or hereafter located thereon the “Owner Premises"; such buildings and improvements now or hereafter located on and comprising part of the Owner Premises, the“Owner Buildings"). B.Lot 6/12 Developer is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, known as 30-25 Queens Boulevard and 29-14 Queens Plaza East, Queens, New York, and identified on the Tax Map as Block 239, Lots 6 and 12, respectively, which is more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being herein called the“Lot6/12Land"). C. Lot 13 Developer is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, known as 29-26 Northern Boulevard, Queens, New York, and identified on the Tax Map as Block 239, Lots 1001,1002 and 1003 (formerly known as Lot 13),which is more particularly described in Exhibit C annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “Lot 13 Land"; the Lot 13 Land together with any buildings, improvements, or other structures now or hereafter located thereon,including without limitation the buildings currently under construction and approaching completion, the “Lot 13 Premises"; such building and improvements now or hereafter located on and comprising part of the Lot 13 Premises, the “Lot 13 Building"). D. The Owner Land, if considered as a separate zoning lot under the Zoning Resolution, generates certain Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) in excess of the floor area currently utilized by the Owner Buildings (such currently utilized floor area, the“Utilized Floor Area"). 1
